sections.heading: 1. Open up the hips
lines: ① Sit in 90/90, switch knees side to side 8 times.
② Knee-to-wall ankle rocks, 10 each side.
③ Widen your stance, toes turned out a little.
④ Hold a comfy-depth squat for 20–30 sec.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: A sharp pinch at the front of the hip,
or pain that lingers — stop and get advice.

caption:
Momo is super bendy, but her squat gets stuck and her tailbone tucks the lower she goes.

Hip shape varies from person to person, so comfortable squat depth and stance width vary too. Rather than forcing depth, adjusting your stance width and toe angle to suit your hips can help.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: 90/90 knee switches × 8, knee-to-wall ankle rocks × 10 each side, then hold a comfortable-depth squat for 20–30 seconds. Stop if you feel a sharp pinch.

Pinching at the front of the hip, catching with pain, or lingering groin pain is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
